title: Organisation and dynamics of individual DNA segments in topologically complex genomes
authors: Saminathan Ramakrishnan; Auro Varat Patnaik; Guglielmo Grillo; Luca Tubiana; Davide Michieletto
one_liner_zh: 该文用dCas9-量子点标记并追踪动基体DNA网络中的DNA环分布与亚扩散动力学，虽涉及DNA动态与结合蛋白，但核心是实验成像而非TF-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Capturing the physical organisation and dynamics of genomic regions is one of the major open challenges in biology. The kinetoplast DNA (kDNA) is a topologically complex genome, made by thousands of DNA (mini and maxi) circles interlinked into a two-dimensional Olympic network. The organisation and dynamics of these DNA circles are poorly understood. In this paper, we show that dCas9 linked to Quantum Dots can efficiently label different classes of DNA minicircles in kDNA. We use this method to study the distribution and dynamics of different classes of DNA minicircles within the network. We discover that maxicircles display a preference to localise at the periphery of the network and that they undergo subdiffusive dynamics. From the latter, we can also quantify the effective network stiffness, confirming previous indirect estimations via AFM. Our method could be used more generally, to quantify the location, dynamics and material properties of genomic regions in other complex genomes, such as that of bacteria, and to study their behaviour in the presence of DNA-binding proteins.
abstract_zh: 捕捉基因组区域的物理组织和动态是生物学中主要未解挑战之一。动基体DNA（kDNA）是一种拓扑复杂的基因组，由数千个DNA（小环和大环）圆环相互连接成二维奥林匹克网络。这些DNA圆环的组织和动态目前了解甚少。在本文中，我们展示了与量子点连接的dCas9能够高效标记kDNA中不同类别的DNA小环。我们利用此方法研究网络内不同类别DNA小环的分布和动态。我们发现大环倾向于定位在网络外围，并表现出亚扩散动态。从后者中，我们还能量化有效网络刚度，证实了先前通过原子力显微镜（AFM）的间接估计。我们的方法可更广泛地应用于其他复杂基因组（如细菌基因组）中基因组区域的位置、动态和材料性质的量化，并研究其在DNA结合蛋白存在下的行为。
